title: How to pitch any of these
lead: Lead with the money: who pays, how much, how often.
detail: Put revenue math on one slide; cost per inspection is $0.0003–0.01, so gross margin can top 90%. Name a design partner in the room (MKBANK, Uzcard, BYD Royal Motors, the Central Bank). Show the path from one module to a platform and the next two markets.
source: Report: shared build kit and hackathon intel

title: What is still unverified
lead: Every price is an estimate; no customer has confirmed they would pay.
detail: Some facts rest on one weak source: the UZS rate, "1,700 fines in 3 days", Cobalt's 30.1% share. No source was found for the helmet rule, truck overhang limit, minimum yellow time or a CNG passenger-exit rule. Phone-browser speeds are unmeasured.
